dt-example.title: Scroller
dt-example.info:
The [Scroller extension](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/scroller) for DataTables provides high performance virtual scroller for DataTables, allowing long lists of data to be displays as if it were a single continuous display, but without the overhead of actually displaying everything all at once! The scroll position is part of the DataTables' state and thus can interact with StateRestore, as demonstrated in this example.
The `scroller` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the Scroller position in the state.
